prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1479; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you reported in Houston, Texas. Is it all right if we proceed?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened before the impact.

A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane. Traffic had been moving slowly, so I had come to a complete stop and my foot was on the brake.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle approaching?

A: Not really. I checked my mirror a moment before, but I didn't see anything close. The next thing I knew, I felt a hard jolt from behind.

Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was going at impact?

A: I honestly couldn't say. It didn't look like it was going very fast, but the impact was stronger than I expected.

Q: Did you exit your vehicle at the scene?

A: I did, briefly. I walked around to check the bumper. The other driver came over and we exchanged information. A police officer arrived and filed a report.

Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that evening. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and a lower back strain.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn to check my blind spot. My lower back aches when I sit for long periods, and I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to your neck or back?

A: No, nothing that required treatment. I've had normal aches now and then, but nothing like this.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add?

A: Just that I'm still dealing with the pain, and I'd like to get this resolved as soon as possible.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
